The Subtask Name: Determine Director Birth Order

Agents:
- Agent: WebSurfer
  -- Action: Performed internet searches to gather information about the directors and their birthdates.
  -- Observation: Found that Jorge Brum do Canto was born on February 10, 1910, and Monte Hellman was born on July 12, 1929.
  -- Thought: Compared the birth years to determine which director was born earlier.
  -- Result: Determined that Jorge Brum do Canto was born earlier than Monte Hellman.

- Agent: Planner
  -- Action: Coordinated the tasks and analysis of the information gathered.
  -- Observation: Received the birthdates from WebSurfer.
  -- Thought: Compared the birth years to determine the result.
  -- Result: Confirmed that Jorge Brum do Canto was born earlier.
